stories.title: Yemen's Houthis capture a Red Sea island in threat to shipping
stories.description: Iranian-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen have captured a strategic island in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. The move threatens Saudi oil exports through a key commercial lane. And Saudi Arabia said it shut down a major oil pipeline as a precaution after it came under attack.

stories.title: Amid war and sanctions, many Iranians are losing their jobs and struggling to get by
